Phone Service Update

Phone Service Update

The City Department Phone Lines, including the Fire Hall Phone Line, are back up and running.

Call individual departments directly via the information on our Contacts page or call 311 to be directed to a department by Staff.

Thank you for your patience while our phone service was being restored over these last few months.

Learn more about the relocation to the mall at www.dawsoncreek.ca/city-hall-relocation.
